prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original square 1024x1024 World of Warcraft addon project icon for Palaver, an NPC conversation and quest reading addon.
Primary request: A single stout antique speech bubble made of thick warm parchment held in a massive gilded brass rim, with exactly three large round embossed gold conversation dots across its centre. Slight three-quarter tilt, almost frontal, very strong recognisable speech-bubble silhouette, its short substantial tail points down-left. Cream and honey parchment with soft painted fibres and darkened edges. A narrow dark turquoise enamel band sits just inside the chunky gold rim. One small emerald cabochon at the base of the tail. The object occupies about 85 percent of the canvas with all edges visible.
Style: Match a cohesive existing family of World of Warcraft inventory icons: vivid hand-painted fantasy illustration, very bold angular brushwork visible in all surfaces, chunky exaggerated forms, thick faceted golden bevels with bright yellow-gold sculpted highlights and rich burnt-orange shadows, saturated turquoise and emerald details, deep inky navy painterly vignette. This should look like the same illustrator who painted a big parchment-and-turquoise magical tome, a thick golden keyring, and a battle-worn blue steel shield with a gold rim. Rich game-item painting, never a smooth realistic product render. Crisp silhouette and readable 32–64 pixel thumbnail, large simple forms rather than filigree.
Backdrop: opaque full-bleed dark midnight-navy square with subtle blue brushwork behind the hero object and quiet near-black corners. No outer border, no rounded app tile, no scenery.
Constraints: ONLY one finished icon, no text, letters, typography, wordmark, exclamation or question mark, logo sheet, watermark, mockup, screenshot, books, scrolls, quills, characters, faces, mouths, hands, shields, keys, faction crests, chains, sparkles, excessive magical aura, photorealism, flat vector graphics or glossy 3D rendering.
